source: UNICEF Nigeria Humanitarian Flash Update Cholera Borno State 7 June 2026
processing_notes: Source states: 'Affected local government areas in Borno state include Maiduguri, Jere, Mafa, Konduga, Magumeri, Monguno, Kwaya Kusa, and Ngala. processing_notes: Source states: 'The most affected LGAs are Maiduguri Metropolitan Council (MMC), Jere, Monguno, Konduga and Mafa, which together account for approximately 92 per cent of all reported cases in the state.
